desc: Derive and verify the transition formula: delta(k→k+1) = 2·S_x − c·(N−1) with x = M−1−k, S_x = sum of 0-indexed positions of value x, c = count of x (verified against Samples 1 and 2)
Simplify preprocessing: only per-value count cnt[x] and position-sum spos[x] needed
Implement final Python solution: fast I/O, single pass for cnt/spos, Fenwick for f(0), delta loop for k=0..M-2, print M lines; 64-bit-safe via Python ints, O(N log M + M) complexity
Verify edge cases mentally: M=1 (empty delta loop, f(0)=0), N=1, duplicates; output ordering confirmed (line i ↔ k=i−1)
